# Overlay primitives — placement contracts

- `menu` submenus shift up before they shrink. The height clamp is floored at `MIN_MENU_HEIGHT`, so clamping first leaves rows off-screen; clamp only what is left after the shift.
- A floating panel is placed in two commits, and the first is unplaced. Any new correction in the placement effect must skip that commit, or it freezes a measurement of a panel that was never there (`maxHeight` is never lowered again until close).
- `popover` keeps its panel inside the window: keep the requested side if it fits, flip only to a side with more room, scroll a panel too tall for either, clamp the cross-axis offset. An unmeasured height means "not known yet", not "fits nowhere".
- `menu` and `popover` also close through `closeOnFrameFocus` (`frame-focus.ts`): a press inside a frame never reaches this document, so a panel with its own outside-press listener calls it too.
- `dialog` Escape closes only the top dialog. A control whose Escape means "abandon this edit" must call `preventDefault()` + `stopPropagation()` (as `menu.tsx`'s `consume()` does), or it closes the dialog underneath and loses its draft.
- `popover`'s `viewport` panel, every `Dialog` overlay and the `tooltip` are shown in the top layer (`components/ui/top-layer.ts`, `popover="manual"`), so no `z-index` or stacking context of an ancestor can paint over them; a dialog opened from a viewport popover lands over it, and the tooltip is raised again for every tip, so it lands over a panel opened before it. A `Menu` or a `context-menu` is still painted inside its ancestors' stacking contexts.
- A scrolling container that clips declares it by providing `MenuAnchorContext` as `viewport` (as `dialog` does), so menus inside go `fixed`. `Popover` takes the same choice per call site via `anchor="viewport"`.
- A `fixed` panel undoes any CSS `zoom` above it (`counterZoomStyle` in `css-zoom.ts`, read off the trigger for `menu`/`popover`; `context-menu` divides its cursor anchor's offsets by the zoom it was raised in): inside a zoomed ancestor (a command-center card scaled with the graph) its fixed offsets and size would otherwise be scaled too. At zoom 1 it adds nothing.
- `dialog` portals its overlay to `document.body`, so no ancestor's `overflow`, `transform` or `zoom` reaches it. A `menu` or `popover` treats a press, or focus entering a frame, inside a modal dialog that does not hold its panel as inside (`modal-above.ts`): such a dialog was opened above it, often from its own content.
- A dismissible full-screen `dialog` holds a browser history entry while open (`usePhoneBackEntry`, owner `full-screen-dialog`): Back closes it, and its ✕, Escape and backdrop pop that entry, so `onClose` runs once, on the popstate. Its header sits inside the safe area and its ✕ is 44px.
